title: Frontend batch 2: owner-override expiry, search-index render-time reset, mirrorError removal

approvals.evidence: auto-approved: no protected path (components/IssueWorkspace.tsx only), no migration

body.design_ref: None -- no open design question; the render-time state adjustment is React's own documented pattern for exactly this case (resetting derived state on a prop/computed-value change without an extra Effect-driven render), and the mirrorError removal follows the same documentation's guidance against state that exists only to feed a second Effect.

steps.title: Add ASSIGN_OVERRIDE_WINDOW_MS module constant; give notify an optional durationMs parameter (default 4500); add armedAt to pendingAssign's ref shape.

commitCell's 'owner' case: gate the override confirmation on armedAt being within ASSIGN_OVERRIDE_WINDOW_MS of now, re-arming and re-notifying (with the toast held open for the same window) rather than confirming when it has expired.

Replace the searchActive-reset useEffect with a render-time adjustment: track prevDeferredSearch in state, and reset searchActive to 0 synchronously when deferredSearch has changed since the last render.

Remove mirrorError state and its dedicated notify Effect; call notify directly inside the debounced mirror-save Effect on failure, deduplicated against a new lastMirrorError ref so a repeated identical failure is not renotified.

Full verification: tsc, a11y lint, tenancy, attribution, contracts, scenario suite. Attempted a live browser check via the dev server; blocked by this environment holding no sign-in credentials for the configured identity provider (identityEstablished() is true against this database), so the check could not get past /signin -- recorded as an unverified-in-this-session gap in the validation result rather than claimed.
steps.verify_command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:tenancy && npm run audit:attribution && npm run audit:contracts && npm run validate:scenarios

commit_boundaries: All five steps as one commit: three independent findings in one file (a timing bound, a render-timing fix, and an Effect-chain removal), each low-risk in isolation, closed together because they share one review, one verification run, and one PR.
body.rollback: Revert the single commit. Step 2 carries the only step with a real behavioural change to a security-adjacent decision (whether an owner-availability override is recorded) -- verified by tracing every one of the four transitions (fresh refusal, in-window confirm, expired repeat, different row/owner) against the existing scenario suite and by reading availabilityForAssignment's own contract to confirm nothing about its refusal shape changed.
